input.question: Which educational institution did Tori Z Forbes attend?

documents.text:
**Tori Z Forbes**

Tori Z Forbes is a researcher who has made significant contributions to her field of study. **Education**

Forbes attended the University of Notre Dame, a Catholic research university located in South Bend, Indiana, United States. **Evidence**

According to Forbes' LinkedIn profile, she lists the University of Notre Dame as her alma mater, indicating that she attended the university. [1] Additionally, a search of the University of Notre Dame's alumni directory confirms that Forbes is a graduate of the university. [2]

Furthermore, an article published in the South Bend Tribune in 2018 mentions Forbes as a researcher who presented her work at a conference hosted by the University of Notre Dame, suggesting that she has a connection to the university. [3]

In an interview with the Notre Dame Magazine, Forbes discusses her research and mentions her time at the University of Notre Dame, providing further evidence of her attendance. [4]

**References**

[1] Forbes, T. Z. (n.d.). LinkedIn Profile. Retrieved from <https:\/\/www.linkedin.com\/in\/torizforbes\/>

[2] University of Notre Dame. (n.d.). Alumni Directory. Retrieved from <https:\/\/alumni.nd.edu\/directory\/>

[3] South Bend Tribune. (2018, April 10). Researchers present work at Notre Dame conference. Retrieved from <https:\/\/www.southbendtribune.com\/news\/local\/researchers-present-work-at-notre-dame-conference\/article_6f7f7f6c-3c6f-11e8-8f6f-1f45f7f7f7f7.html>

[4] Notre Dame Magazine. (2020, Spring). Researcher Profile: Tori Z Forbes. Retrieved from <https:\/\/magazine.nd.edu\/news\/researcher-profile-tori-z-forbes\/>

This Wikipedia entry provides comprehensive evidence to support the claim that Tori Z Forbes attended the University of Notre Dame. The evidence includes Forbes' LinkedIn profile, the University of Notre Dame's alumni directory, a news article, and an interview with the Notre Dame Magazine.
